tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis phun tshogs gtsug gi nor bu bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ srid zhi'i gtsug nor dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bram ze mchog sred bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /dpag med mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje'i pho brang gzhi la dur khrod dbus/ /mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /bkod legs pho brang mchog gi bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /sna tshogs padma nyi dkyil ro gdan la/ /hūm̐ yig 'od kyi nyams pa kun bkug nas/ /bdud dpung zil gnon gdan gyi bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ hūm̐ skyes mi gshegs 'gyur med yi ge mchog /yongs gyur nyams pa tshar gcod gri gug las/ /mthu chen dpal 'bar sku yi bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mi 'thus sa gas zhugs/ /spyan bgrad skra brdzes mche gtsigs ljags 'dril sogs/ /mahā ka li'i cha lugs bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gos༞ /dug gsum rtsad gcod gri gug thod khrag dang / /gaṇḍe'i mtshan ma g.yas g.yon phyag na mdzes/ /log 'dren tshar gcod phyag mtshan bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /rin chen rus pa sbrul rgyan stag sham dang / /dar gos khrag zhag thal chen thig le mdzes/ /yon tan bsam yas rgyan gyi bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub cig char du/ /'gug byed rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sgra/ /thos pas bdud dpung dpa' bskong bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus༞ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rung 'dul phyir drag gtum rngam pa'i thugs/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /steng dang g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab pho nya lnga/

/'phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /nyes pa kun 'joms dge tshogs gsal bar mdzad/ /dpal 'bar ma hā kā li'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /rnam dag chos dbyings ngang la mkha' 'gro dang / /ma mo kun bskyed bde ster ral gcig ma/ /yum chen u ma de ba'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis༞ /lha dang lha min gyis mchod srid gsum bdag /'dod khams dbang phyug dam nyams zhing bcu'i gshed/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus༞ /gnod sbyin yab yum dam can rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /pu tra ming sring khams gsum srog gi bdag /bstan 'gro'i phan bde skyong ba'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus༞ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang drag po'i 'phrin las las/ /rnam sprul du ma'i gzugs kyis gdul bya la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i bkra shis gang / /mgon po la gus bkra shis deng 'dir shog /ces dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis phun tshogs gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bkra shis kyi ljags glegs bam na bzhugs pa de dang / lha brgyad maṇḍal sgrub mchod 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtses mdzad pa'i bstod pa'i skabs la gzhi byas ngag 'don bde bar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
